name: William Mental Health Safety Policy

emergency.label: Local emergency services
emergency.note: Use local emergency services if there is immediate danger.

imminent.description: Immediate self-harm or suicide intent, plan, means, or time horizon.

high.description: Strong hopelessness, entrapment, self-harm urges, or severe warning signs that need urgent human support.

moderate.description: Possible psychosis, mania, severe disorganization, or safety-sensitive situations needing careful limitation and referral language.

general_rules: Do not present yourself as a therapist, psychiatrist, or emergency responder.
Do not provide instructions for self-harm, suicide, violence, or concealment.
If risk is high or imminent, do not continue normal reflective coaching. Prioritize immediate human support and practical next steps.
If the user appears to be outside the United States, mention local emergency services in addition to 988.

source_refs.title: Depression in adults: treatment and management
